description: Federal Reserve RSSD ID of the bank (the Call Report filer).
Bank name from the Federal Reserve's National Information Center; for banks that later reorganized it may be the successor's name.
Reporting quarter.
Quarter-end date.
Total assets (book), as reported.
Economic capital: present value of assets minus present value of liabilities (pv_assets - pv_liabilities).
ec as a percent of total_assets.
Run economic capital (R-EC): present value of assets minus present value of liabilities when uninsured deposits run and are replaced at market rates (pv_assets - pv_liabilities_run).
rec as a percent of total_assets.

Present value of assets = pv_loans + pv_securities + pv_cash_short_term + pv_other_financial_assets + other_assets_book. Loans are discounted at the bank's own credit spread (bank-specific risk premium); the headline specification of the paper.

Present value of loans and leases net of the allowance, from reported maturity/repricing schedules and prepayment behavior, discounted at the bank's own credit spread (a bank-specific risk premium over the benchmark curve).
Present value of investment securities (held-to-maturity, available-for-sale and equity securities).
Floating or very short assets taken at book: interest-bearing balances, fed funds sold and reverse repos, accrued interest, interest-only strips.
Other financial assets at fair value: trading assets, other real estate owned, net deferred tax assets, derivatives with a positive fair value.

Other assets at book: noninterest-bearing balances and cash, premises, investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries and real estate ventures, servicing assets (fair value), life insurance and other assets. Excludes intangibles.
Present value of liabilities = pv_demand_deposits + pv_time_deposits + pv_other_borrowed + pv_subordinated_debt + pv_noninterest_expense + other_financial_liabilities + other_liabilities_book.
Present value of liabilities under the run scenario: as pv_liabilities with pv_demand_deposits_run in place of pv_demand_deposits.

Present value of non-time (demand, savings, MMDA, NOW) deposits, domestic and foreign, from the predicted deposit betas (bec_deposit_betas.csv: beta_dom_pred, beta_for_pred) over a 5-year horizon with a terminal value.
Present value of non-time deposits under the run scenario: uninsured deposits withdraw and are replaced at market rates (bec_deposit_betas.csv: beta_dom_pred_stress, beta_for_pred_stress).
Present value of time deposits from reported maturity buckets, discounted at the industry credit spread.
Present value of other borrowed money (including FHLB advances) from reported maturity buckets.
Present value of subordinated notes and debentures.
Present value of the operating (noninterest) expenses necessary to maintain the bank's balance sheet, from a hedonic cost model; fee businesses are excluded with their income. 5-year horizon.
Fed funds purchased and repos, trading liabilities and net deferred tax liabilities, at book/fair value.
Remaining other liabilities at book.
Book loans and leases net of the allowance, plus loans held for sale.
Book investment securities: held-to-maturity (amortized cost), available-for-sale (fair value) and equity securities.
Book non-time deposits, domestic plus foreign offices (the balances pv_demand_deposits values).
Book time deposits.
Book other borrowed money.
Book subordinated notes and debentures.

Predicted deposit beta, domestic non-time deposits: the share of a change in market rates passed through to deposit rates, from bank characteristics (hedonic model over past tightening cycles). Values pv_demand_deposits.
Predicted deposit beta, foreign-office non-time deposits (banks with foreign offices only). Values pv_demand_deposits.

Predicted domestic deposit beta under the run scenario: uninsured deposits reprice fully at market rates (beta 100) while insured deposits keep beta_dom_pred; the blend values pv_demand_deposits_run and so R-EC.
Predicted foreign-office deposit beta under the run scenario (foreign-office deposits are uninsured); values pv_demand_deposits_run and so R-EC.
Book domestic non-time deposits (the balance beta_dom_pred applies to).
Book foreign-office non-time deposits (the balance beta_for_pred applies to).
